value.rationale: K_{1,1,n} is a natural first non-bipartite complete multipartite family adjacent to the complete-bipartite case treated in the initiating paper. The exact result separates static and game behavior: dom(G_n)=3 for every n>=2, yet one starting convention has game value 2 and the other 1, with the roles switching at every parity change. This is an infinite structural phenomenon with explicit strategies rather than an isolated small-graph computation.
